workflows.trigger: new or resumed OpenCode/LSP workstation request
steps: treat any supplied repository path as a hint until git rev-parse and canonical origin succeed
when the hint is not a Git checkout, run Resolve-AgentSwitchboardCheckout.ps1 with exact expected branch/head
search only bounded nearby AgentSwitchBoard* candidates and LOCALAPPDATA checkouts
if no canonical checkout exists, create an isolated LOCALAPPDATA clone without rewriting the hinted folder
validate the exact-head isolated harness worktree
inspect existing config locations without printing file contents
workflows.completionGate: exact canonical repository worktree/head and runtime classification recorded

workflows.trigger: intake proves supported OpenCode runtime and exact AgentSwitchboard repository
steps: query OpenCode provider model names without credentials
workflows.completionGate: owned overlay and launcher exist, receipt/report written, existing OpenCode config and tracked checkout unchanged

workflows.trigger: inspect/configure/verify returns nonzero or repository resolution fails
steps: for a non-Git path, preserve it and route through the checkout resolver instead of treating its name as repository proof
repair first deterministic failing boundary only
stopConditions: Git unavailable and cannot be repaired in owned scope
remote exact branch/head cannot be fetched without force

steps: record preferred path hint separately from resolved canonical worktree
record proof ceiling and one exact next command
workflows.completionGate: a low-capability agent can continue without rediscovering repository authority or paths
